applicabilityBasis.summary: AUSD is a fiat-backed U.S. dollar stablecoin with 1:1 redemption, reserve attestations, and institutional payment and settlement use cases.

genius.licensingRegulator: BMA (current issuer); OCC granted Agora National Trust Bank preliminary conditional charter approval on 2026-09-18, with final approval and permission to commence business still subject to preopening requirements
genius.notes: OCC Corporate Decision 1393 dated September 18, 2026 grants preliminary conditional approval to Agora National Trust Bank, a proposed affiliate of current AUSD issuer Agora Bermuda Limited. The decision explicitly withholds final approval and authorization to commence business until preopening requirements are met. It describes a future cutover of AUSD reserve assets and liabilities from Agora Bermuda to the Bank after establishment. This is not evidence of completed issuer migration or GENIUS PPSI approval, so issuerEntity and authorizationStatus remain unchanged. The negativeEvidenceReview below records the historical June 18 search and is not a current charter-status assertion.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Agora's OCC national trust bank charter application (received 2026-04-20) is under review with no approval granted. No GENIUS Act PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or registered foreign-issuer exception was found for AUSD. GENIUS Act rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase with no PPSI approvals issued to any issuer as of 2026-06-18.
